row.notes: systems = CarLive+0x380 container. Looks for an existing system whose type name (system vt+0x38 -> data, data vt+8 -> name) equals section_desc+0x10 (case-insensitive); if none, calls the factory section_desc+0x38(container owner = CarLive), appends it to car+0x3a0[count++] and re-runs Car_Build_VtfComponents to refresh the +0x530..+0x5e0 cache. Then tail-calls system vt+8(system, section_node) = data->Read(node). So a reset on an existing car re-reads the section into the SAME system object (no realloc)
